title: observe-d / 07 Request explorer
description: Every request (llm_requests). Paste a trace_id / request_id for the drill-down.

list.name: org
list.label: Org
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT org_id FROM llm_requests WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT org_id FROM llm_requests WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM llm_requests WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND model != ''
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM llm_requests WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND model != ''

list.name: status
list.label: Status
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM llm_requests WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM llm_requests WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, status, count() AS requests FROM llm_requests FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (length([${org:singlequote}]) = 0 OR org_id IN (${org:singlequote})) AND (length([${model:singlequote}]) = 0 OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND (length([${status:singlequote}]) = 0 OR status IN (${status:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, status ORDER BY time
SELECT minute AS time, missing_engine_span / greatest(routed, 1) AS missing_engine_span_ratio FROM join_health WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) ORDER BY minute

SELECT ts, trace_id, request_id, org_id, app_id, model, pod, status, finish_reason, tokens_in, tokens_cached, tokens_out, round(ttft_us / 1e3, 1) AS ttft_ms, round(tpot_us / 1e3, 2) AS tpot_ms, round(queue_us / 1e3, 1) AS queue_ms, round(gateway_us / 1e3, 1) AS gateway_ms, prefix_hit_predicted, prefix_hit_actual, preempted FROM llm_requests FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND (length([${org:singlequote}]) = 0 OR org_id IN (${org:singlequote})) AND (length([${model:singlequote}]) = 0 OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND (length([${status:singlequote}]) = 0 OR status IN (${status:singlequote})) ORDER BY status = 'ok', ttft_us DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Drill-down: set the trace_id / request_id variable

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, trace_id, request_id, org_id, app_id, user_id, session_id, model, engine, pod, node, status, response_code, finish_reason, tokens_in, tokens_cached, tokens_out, gateway_us, routing_us, queue_us, prefill_us, decode_us, ttft_us, tpot_us, e2e_us, route_candidates, prefix_hit_predicted, prefix_hit_actual, fallback_reason, preempted, temperature, top_p, max_tokens FROM (SELECT * FROM llm_requests FINAL WHERE trace_id = '${trace}' OR request_id = '${trace}' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, SpanName, SpanKind, round(Duration / 1e6, 2) AS duration_ms, StatusCode, SpanId, ParentSpanId, SpanAttributes FROM otel_traces WHERE TraceId = (SELECT trace_id FROM llm_requests WHERE trace_id = '${trace}' OR request_id = '${trace}' LIMIT 1) ORDER BY Timestamp

panels.title: GPU state of the request's pod (±30 s)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, gpu_index, round(compute_active_percent, 1) AS compute_pct, round(mem_bw_active_percent, 1) AS hbm_bw_pct, round(power_watts) AS watts, round(temp_celsius, 1) AS temp_c, sm_clock_mhz, throttle_reasons FROM gpu_samples_v AS g, (SELECT * FROM llm_requests FINAL WHERE trace_id = '${trace}' OR request_id = '${trace}' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) AS r WHERE g.pod = r.pod AND g.ts BETWEEN toDateTime(r.ts) - 30 AND toDateTime(r.ts) + 30 ORDER BY ts, gpu_index

panels.title: Engine state at that time (±60 s)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS t, MetricName, round(avg(Value), 3) AS value FROM otel_metrics_gauge AS m, (SELECT * FROM llm_requests FINAL WHERE trace_id = '${trace}' OR request_id = '${trace}' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) AS r WHERE m.MetricName LIKE 'llm.%' AND m.Attributes['pod'] = r.pod AND m.TimeUnix BETWEEN r.ts - INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND r.ts + INTERVAL 60 SECOND GROUP BY t, MetricName ORDER BY t, MetricName

panels.title: Kubernetes events for the pod (±5 min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.ts, e.reason, e.type, e.message FROM k8s_events AS e, (SELECT * FROM llm_requests FINAL WHERE trace_id = '${trace}' OR request_id = '${trace}' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1) AS r WHERE e.name = r.pod AND e.ts BETWEEN r.ts - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND r.ts + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE ORDER BY e.ts
